blocking_invariants: No universal CR, encounter level, threat number or cross-domain power scalar may be invented from the current evidence.
Within-domain target bands may not be promoted into cross-domain equivalence.
Source mechanics are immutable under balance analysis.
Observations and recommendations remain separate from source truth.
Permission filtering occurs before protected benchmark inputs, derived counts, comparison results, exports, diagnostics or AI context.
Unknown/source-unspecified values remain unknown and are represented in uncertainty rather than coerced to numeric defaults.
Action economy, environment, objectives and resource pressure remain independently inspectable.
Mixed-scale analysis requires explicit interaction rules; visual size or narrative importance does not create numeric equivalence.
Boss, wave, reinforcement and retreat methodology may organize existing rules but may not invent new source mechanics to make an encounter fit a target.
AI may summarize, compare and propose recommendations only; human/governed owning workflows approve any consequential change.
No guaranteed-balance claim is permitted; every assessment is bounded by stated evidence and uncertainty.
PPIA-11 design work activates no application runtime, STAGE-A-A2, release, deployment, tester, paid-service or production-credential capability.
